{{Quote|One of Tormen's lackeys forwarded a star chart to a system called Voss. The place isn't even on most maps yet.|Mako|<ref name="TOR" />}}
The '''Voss system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Allied Tion sector/Legends|Allied Tion sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]].
